gloss: to get information out of; to draw out

definitions.gloss: to get information out of; to draw out; to extract
definitions.explanation: To skillfully question someone to obtain information they may be reluctant to share. Implies persistence or persuasion in the questioning.

examples.japanese: {刑事|けいじ}は{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}から{真実|しんじつ}を{聞|き}き{出|だ}した。
examples.english: The detective got the truth out of the suspect.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}から{学校|がっこう}での{出来事|できごと}を{聞|き}き{出|だ}すのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's difficult to get children to tell you what happened at school.

examples.japanese: うまく{聞|き}き{出|だ}せば、{秘密|ひみつ}を{教|おし}えてくれるかもしれない。
examples.english: If you ask skillfully, they might tell you the secret.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{聞|き}き{出|だ}す → {聞|き}き{出|だ}さない (negative)
・{聞|き}き{出|だ}す → {聞|き}き{出|だ}して (te-form)
・{聞|き}き{出|だ}す → {聞|き}き{出|だ}した (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {聞|き}く (to ask/listen) + {出|だ}す (out)

The ～{出|だ}す pattern here indicates extracting or bringing out something hidden.

COLLOCATIONS:
・{情報|じょうほう}を{聞|き}き{出|だ}す - to extract information
・{秘密|ひみつ}を{聞|き}き{出|だ}す - to get a secret out of someone
・{本音|ほんね}を{聞|き}き{出|だ}す - to draw out someone's true feelings
・{証言|しょうげん}を{聞|き}き{出|だ}す - to obtain testimony

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive verb. The person questioned takes から, and the information extracted takes を.
